title: Episode 0 · Start here — how this show works, and the first thing to do today
summary: The preface. What The Empirical Dad is (a daily, day-numbered briefing from the first positive test to age three, written for the father), how every claim is graded out loud as established, strong or emerging, what never makes the show, and how risk is always given a size. How to find your day: OBs count from the first day of the last period, so Day 28 is the missed period and Day 280 is the due date. The seven-angle weekly cycle (Body, Brain, Physiology, Parents, Adventure, Protocol, Myths). Then the earliest-days evidence: how hCG and home tests actually work, the honest miscarriage numbers and why most losses were decided at conception, folic acid and the neural-tube window that closes before the first appointment, alcohol and smoking, and what the cohorts say a father's involvement does from pregnancy onward.
action: Confirm she is taking a prenatal vitamin with at least 400 µg folic acid, starting today. If there is a family history of neural tube defects or she takes seizure medication, ask the OB this week about the 4 mg dose. Then find your day number and start there.
